descripcion: PETER STREET, 9. Once personas bajo un techo y ni un caso.
_por_que_importa_aunque_no_de_nada: Casa fuera del círculo del plano; nadie lo dice.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

abre.texto: Eleven people live in this house, counting my lodgers. No one has died. You are the third man this week to ask.

memoria.texto: Ask what you need, Reverend. I have a house to run.

opciones.texto: Where does the house get its water?

agua.texto: All eleven of us fetch our water from the Peter Street pump. Not one of us has been ill.
